verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product. Its only fleet-style capability is codebase scans, which 'deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs and vulnerabilities' (cubic-docs-21), so the axis applies. However, those agents serve one fixed purpose, scanning for bugs, and the longest documented run is Ultrareview at about 30 minutes (cubic-docs-43). Missing for 10: user-launched fleets working on different, arbitrary tasks; evidence of agents running for hours or days; controls for orchestrating or monitoring parallel agents; independent corroboration.
